paragraphs: Markets over the last day: the eight tracked equity indices moved +0.85% on average, with Hang Seng strongest (+1.79%) and Nikkei 225 weakest (-0.02%). Brent crude changed +0.42% to 104.72. Gold changed +1.43% to 4,216.2998. Bitcoin changed +1.13% to 82,602.2266. The US 10-year yield stands at 5.244%, a relative move of +0.25%. Among the firms tracked, Freeport-McMoRan (+3.58%) and Gold Miners (ETF) (+2.95%) moved the most.
